title: Untangling a Branch From the Wrong Base
description: Amit's reporting branch was created before main moved forward, so unrelated main changes now appear in its diff.
objective: Bring feature/reporting up to date with main while keeping its reporting work intact.

whatToDo.text: Find where feature/reporting split from main.
Bring feature/reporting up to the current main.
Verify that only the reporting changes remain.

hints: Compare the commit history of feature/reporting and main to see where they diverged.
Update feature/reporting from main, then check the final diff.

intro.message: Amit's reporting branch was created before main moved forward. First, figure out where the two branches diverged.

updateBranch.message: Good. The reporting branch now includes the current main history and Amit's reporting work is still intact.

success.message: That explains it — diff looks clean now. Appreciate you digging into what actually happened instead of just guessing.

failure.message: The branch isn't in the expected final state. Update it from current main, preserve both reporting commits, and make sure only the reporting changes remain.
